# unifi_firewall_policy_flow_reporting (Resource)

Owns only flow reporting on an existing user-defined firewall policy through the official Network Integration API. Requires an API key and explicit official API UUIDs; legacy IDs and provider site names are not interchangeable. Qualified for Network 11.0.99. Destroy relinquishes ownership without changing the policy. Do not concurrently manage this field through another resource or UI. Import uses `official-site-uuid/official-policy-uuid`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires an Integration API key. Obtain these UUIDs from the official API;
# legacy IDs and provider site names are not interchangeable.
resource "unifi_firewall_policy_flow_reporting" "example" {
  site_id   = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
  policy_id = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
  enabled   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether matching traffic appears in Insights Flows.
- `policy_id` (String) Official Integration API user-defined policy UUID.
- `site_id` (String) Official Integration API site UUID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Official site UUID and policy UUID separated by `/`.
